CURRENT STATE (2026-10-02, review-5 R5-17): the ceiling only ever turned down through the M9 10.2 migrations, and the live figures were the structured fields, not the 2026-09-28 prose above: totalCeiling 1402 across 78 diagnostic-bearing sources (63 non-conforming entry points plus 15 bin/lib files) and an any-annotation budget of 91; the 1560/1571/1579 figures above are HISTORICAL baselines. TERMINAL STATE (M9 task 10.4/10.5, 2026-10-09): the lane is BLOCKING with 0 diagnostics, 77 of 77 entry points conforming, 0 exemptions, no per-file ceilings and no diagnostic-silencing annotations. Two structural findings made the earlier 1402 figure a FLOOR rather than a measurement, and both are closed here. (1) DECLARATION SHADOWING: `tsconfig.bin.json` used to `include` `bin/**/*.d.mts` as well as `bin/**/*.mjs`, and TypeScript treats a hand-written sibling declaration as a module's authoritative type and DROPS the counted implementation from the program, so 53 bin implementations - 30 of them carrying 952 real diagnostics, including bin/agent-state.mjs (138), bin/agent-continuity-protocol.mjs (171) and bin/lib/operator-cli.mjs (109) - were never checked at all while the lane reported a clean number for them. The include now matches the `.mjs` implementations only, the declarations are still honoured for importers through module resolution and `skipLibCheck`, and a new hard error `BIN_TYPECHECK_DECLARATION_SHADOWED` refuses any include pattern that would let a declaration shadow an implementation again. (2) VACUOUS SUCCESS: `runTsc` treated an EMPTY tsc output as `BIN_TYPECHECK_TOOLCHAIN_UNAVAILABLE`, so the first fully clean surface would have been reported as a toolchain failure; tsc exits 0 on a clean surface and 1 when it has diagnostics, and only a spawn error, a kill signal or exit code 2 (configuration error, no per-file judgement) now fails closed. The 1402 -> 0 burn-down therefore annotates 143 implementations, not 77, and the annotation budget reached 0 because every JSDoc object shape is single-line (the detector's `[^}]*` spans newlines, so a multi-line type is a false positive via its ` * ` continuation prefixes) and every optional field is a `Partial<...>` rather than the `?:` form. any new widening annotation of any kind now fails immediately.
